task.title: MacroFactor: send planned meals and nutrition from PerfectPlate
task.description:
## Idea (captured from the owner by voice, 2026-11-18; not yet specced)

The owner tracks what they actually eat (calorie and macro intake) in the MacroFactor app, used only on their phone. They would like PerfectPlate to put its meal data into MacroFactor for them, so planned meals do not have to be re-entered there.

Direction:
1. First: one way, PerfectPlate to MacroFactor (planned or eaten meals with their nutrition).
2. Later, perhaps: MacroFactor back to PerfectPlate (what was actually logged).

## What is unknown

The owner is not sure how to get data in or out of MacroFactor at all. They have seen unofficial, MCP-based projects that reverse engineer its API, but nothing official.

## First step when picked up: research, not build

- Does MacroFactor have an official API, import format, or export? (It exports data files; check what it can import.)
- Does it read from Apple Health / Health Connect? If so, writing nutrition there from a phone could be a supported route, but PerfectPlate is a web app and cannot write to those stores without a native piece.
- Can it import recipes or custom foods from a link, a file, or a share sheet? A per-meal "open in MacroFactor" hand-off may be enough for step 1.
- The unofficial API projects: what they do, how they authenticate, and the risk (terms of service, breakage, storing the owner's MacroFactor credentials).

## Depends on

Nutrition data existing in PerfectPlate, which arrives with the Weekly Meal Planner work. Nothing to send before that.
